about_the_game:
Explore, collect, fight, and light your way through a dark and dreamy wonderland in this 2-4 player resource management campaign!

Beyond mellow pastures and brambly woods is the Dreamland: a labyrinth of vague memories shrouded in mysterious familiarity.

Unravel the fantastical story of four cutely crafted dolls: the willful Beep, dozy Kosvky, dutiful Tchai, and fashionable Bo. Guide a flock of curious sheep spirits who seem eager to help as you encounter halls of obstacles, nooks of secrets, and less-than-friendly dwellers in the shadows.

Face the darkness while you race against the clock! Master the map while you discover its tales! Coordinate with your team to boost your memento score! A magical fantasia awaits you and your friends!

EXPLORE

Traverse a winding manor and an upbeat patisserie world in the first two chapters of act one, with a total of six chapters across three acts. Wrangle wild sheep roaming these worlds with your guiding light and command them in a parade of spirits to carry items, tear down barriers, solve cooperative puzzles, and keep predators at bay.

COLLECT

Scattered across the landscape of the Dreamland are supplies for your fire, items to enhance your playstyle, and mementos of forgotten memories. Uncover the reality of the dream by gathering these mementos at the hearth, all while strengthening your herd.

MANAGE

Your light will slowly trickle away but so will the light of the hearth! Keep an eye on both while also organizing your sheep. Split up to cover more ground or stick close to work together as you venture deeper into the dream.

SHEPHERD YOUR DREAMS!

  • 2-4 player online co-op

  • Four characters with unique personalities

  • Campaign through Six Chapters across Three Acts

  • Experience the fantastical story of the dreamland

  • Achievements & Unlockables!
